issue_context.title: [Bug] [API] cant close milestone
issue_context.body:
as title 
tested with: gitea version 1.12.0-dev
comments:
on `PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{id}` if you send
```json
 "state": "closed"
```
nothing change

review_comments: Do we need to be able to handle reopen?
When reopen, we could just update `is_closed` to `false` and don't change `closed_date_unix` like gitea did before.
